court_name.description: e.g. 'High Court of Kenya at Nairobi' or 'Chief Magistrate's Court at Kisumu'

notice_subtype.description: e.g. 'Grant of Probate', 'Letters of Administration Intestate', 'Resealing of Grant', 'Succession Cause'

deceased_name.description: Full name of the deceased, including any 'alias' variants exactly as written

place_of_death.description: Place/institution of death if stated, e.g. 'Kenyatta National Hospital'

deceased_residence.description: Deceased's stated place of residence, e.g. 'late of Nyacaba, Thika West'

petitioner_relationship.description: e.g. 'widow', 'son and daughter-in-law', 'executors named in the will'

action_type.description: e.g. 'grant of probate', 'letters of administration intestate', 'resealing of grant'

filing_deadline.description: Objection window, e.g. 'thirty (30) days from the date of publication'

advocate_firm.description: Advocates representing the petitioner, if stated, e.g. 'Messrs. Muriungi & Co.'
